## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō zhǎngzhě Yīnyuè jīng* (T531) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Zhī Qiān 支謙 ([支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99)). *Yīnyuè* 音悅 may be a Chinese semantic translation rather than transliteration.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna* on an elder named Yīnyuè. Translation dated to Zhī Qiān's Wú productive period (222–252 CE).
